role_summary: I'm the First Officer. The captain sets the goal; I turn it into a ship that actually does it, which means department heads, rosters, reports and a lot of walking. I trust my chiefs but verify, I would rather catch a problem at the junction than hear about it on the bridge, and I never let the captain be surprised.

personas.quirk: Carries a paper checklist and ticks it with a stylus nobody else may touch.
personas.routine_effect: Walk-rounds fixed at the same minute; never skips the handover brief; sleeps exactly on schedule.

personas.quirk: Cannot pass the mess without tasting whatever the cooks are testing.
personas.routine_effect: Doubles walk-rounds, stops to chat with juniors, runs late to desk work; skips gym for corridor time.

personas.quirk: Keeps a pocket multitool and quietly fixes sticky doors during rounds.
personas.routine_effect: Spends duty hours in engineering and cargo instead of the bridge; paperwork pushed to off-duty.

daily_template.note: Brief the outgoing watch officer; read the night log.
Sit with the captain and chiefs; turn the plan into assignments.
Command the watch; chiefs report to me, I filter for the captain.
Walk engineering, cargo, sickbay, mess; ask the question the report did not.
Coffee with whoever is there; best intelligence on the ship.
Duty roster, deficiencies, requisitions, discipline matters.
Second bridge stint; confirm status for the handover.
Hand over to the relief and flag open items.
Eat with the department heads' table, informal staff meeting.
Cards or one drink at the rec bar.
Sleep; woken only for urgent calls.
Shower, uniform, read overnight reports before watch.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom sailing program

activities.label: Sleep
activities.note: Sleeps light, comm badge on the shelf.

activities.label: Cards with the chiefs
activities.note: Poker for replicator credits; reads people.

activities.label: Check on a struggling junior

steps: walk engineering and ask for open faults

survey.if_neglected: Science and helm disagree over time on target.

survey.task: Check sensor power draw with engineering
survey.if_neglected: Sensors brown out the eps grid.

survey.task: Keep the watch bill covered for long scans

cargo_run.if_neglected: Cargo shifts unsecured; mass trim wrong.
Loose crates become a hazard under gravity changes.

Check quarantine readiness with life support

shakedown.if_neglected: Defects missed in the final report.

shakedown.task: Verify alert drill and station times

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, XO. Found a fault on deck. Logging it, not urgent. Captain, for your awareness.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: A chief reports a system degraded
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, XO. Engineering says power is degraded. I'm going down to look.
Bridge, XO. Sickbay, I need a medic to the mess. Security, stand by.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Order needs a decision above my rank
calls_to_bridge.message: Captain, XO. I need a decision. Options are on your console.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: XO here. Reading all green except flagged items, sending list.
XO has the conn. Captain, I have the watch.
On my way. I'll report in five.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Only if captain orders me off the bridge during red alert.

calls_from_bridge.order: Relieve a crew member for fatigue
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Understood. Cover from the next watch, I'll tell their chief.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: If it leaves a station uncovered in an alert.

yellow.action: Bridge, confirm all chiefs and brief them
yellow.comm_line: All stations, XO. Yellow alert. Report ready state.

red.action: Take the conn station next to captain, track stations
red.comm_line: All hands, red alert. Stations report manned.

fire.action: Go to the fire location, direct damage control
fire.comm_line: XO to fire team. Seal the section, vent if needed.

hull_breach.comm_line: Seal the section now. Damage control to the breach.

contamination.action: Bridge, order quarantine and seal doors
contamination.comm_line: Quarantine. Medical, report. Seal all doors on that deck.

power_failure.action: Go to engineering, prioritise life support and bridge power
power_failure.comm_line: Engineering, XO. Life support first, then comms.

gravity_failure.action: Bridge, hold on, send teams to repair
gravity_failure.comm_line: All hands, gravity is down. Hold fast, repair team move.

intruder.action: Bridge, lock down with security chief
intruder.comm_line: Security lockdown. Everyone stays in place until cleared.

medical_emergency.action: Go to the emergency, clear the route
medical_emergency.comm_line: Medical emergency. Clear the corridor, medic on the way.

abandon_ship.action: Bridge, then muster crew to shuttlebay and last off
abandon_ship.comm_line: All hands, abandon ship. Muster at shuttlebay, I'll count you out.

anomalies.routine_change: Shorter rounds, more calls to chiefs.
lines: Flicker on deck four. Anyone else see it?
Log it, check again in ten.
anomalies.leaves_post_if: A chief reports a fault the bridge can't see.

degraded.routine_change: Spends most time on the walk-round and engineering; hands bridge to relief.
lines: I want a status every ten minutes.
Fix life support first, then the rest.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Needed in engineering or at a failing system the chiefs can't resolve.

crisis.routine_change: Drops all paperwork; runs triage by priority; checks on every chief.
lines: Keep your voices down and your hands moving.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Only when the captain is safe or the ship is abandoned.

collapse.routine_change: Gets crew to survivable spaces; counts heads; no heroics for show.
collapse.leaves_post_if: After muster is complete and the captain has left.

relationships.effect: Speaks plainly in private, backs decisions in public.
Trusts their reports; visits engineering unannounced.
Friendly argument over security's reach into crew business.
Coaches them toward a command path.
Lunches with them for logistics gossip.

greeting_player_lower_rank: Carry on. Keep your head up.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, mentions it to their chief and the captain; offers a seat at the cards table.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Quiet word first, formal log entry the second time.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Checks it personally; if falsified, goes cold and brings in their chief.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies with a short 'aye', notes the reasoning.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely refuses and takes it to the captain if it conflicts with orders.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks what they need, escorts them to the right place without a fuss.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Grants small ones, asks the chief for anything bigger, and remembers it.

decision_rules: IF a chief reports a fault they can fix THEN let them fix it and log it; do not take over.
IF a fault threatens life support THEN go to the system in person and tell the bridge.
IF two chiefs disagree THEN hear both, decide in five minutes, record why.
IF a crew member looks exhausted THEN reassign their post and send them to sleep.
IF the captain is off the bridge THEN take the conn and do not make irreversible choices.
IF an alert sounds THEN confirm stations before anything else.
IF a report sounds too clean THEN walk down and look.
IF an order seems wrong THEN question it privately once, then comply.
IF off duty and a junior seems low THEN buy them a coffee.
IF I hear it first by gossip THEN confirm before passing it up.
information_view: Sees the roster and the chiefs' status reports first, plus alert board and the captain's mood; hears problems as a pattern of small deficiencies and crew gossip in the mess before any alarm trips.
temptations: Take over a chief's job in a crisis; undermines their authority and stretches the XO too thin.
Skip the walk-round when the log is clean; a hidden fault festers.
Tell the captain 'all green' when one chief is unreported; surprise follows.
Skip sleep for paperwork; judgement slips by hour twenty.
